# v2026.10.36

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.36.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.36.md).

This release covers **9 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- The Issued tab is now Finalised, and each finalised invoice shows a Xero badge. ([#178](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/178))
- One Linked column shows each invoice's links to Seazona and Xero as icons. ([#180](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/180))
- The Custom fields page is laid out like a field manager, with each field's type and use in one list. ([#176](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/176))
- A Docs Agent keeps the docs in step with the code after each green build, with its AI cost shown and capped. ([#163](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/163), [#181](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/181))
- A release never stops for a person, and each release reaches npm even while its GitHub release is still a draft. ([#179](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/179), [#182](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/182))

## Changes

- Lay the Custom fields page out like a field manager. ([#176](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/176))
- One Linked column shows each invoice's links to Seazona and Xero as icons. ([#180](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/180))
- Copy OpenClaw's Docs Agent, with its AI cost and a cheaper model through ClawRouter. ([#163](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/163))
- Docs Agent pull requests merge themselves when green, and runs use a cheaper model. ([#181](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/181))

## Fixes

- The Issued tab is now Finalised, and each finalised invoice shows a Xero badge. ([#178](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/178))
- A release never stops for a person; tags are signed only when a key is set. ([#179](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/179))
- Flow NPM Release reads the release manifest from the Publish run. ([#182](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/182))
